title: Adaptation of Mindfulness Training to Treat Chronic Pain in the Military
brief_summary: The overall aim of this study is to test the acceptability and feasibility of an interactive, web-based mindfulness training with active duty soldiers being treated for chronic pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients who have experienced chronic pain for at least 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Do not have any of the following conditions: substance abuse or dependence, psychosis, suicidal ideation in the last 2 months, high levels of trauma symptoms,
* plans to have a permanent change of station or deploy in the coming 6 months, or
* pregnancy
